description: This source file implements the XBSStore class responsible for managing bootstrap configuration data, including reading/writing configuration files, monitoring partner ID changes via inotify, and handling device-specific defaults. It also manages creation of necessary files and directories, and interacts with other components like XBSStoreJournal and hostIf_DeviceInfo.

classes.name: XBSStore
classes.description: Manages bootstrap configuration data, including loading from files, monitoring partner ID changes, and updating configuration parameters.

classes.name: XBSStoreJournal
classes.description: Handles journaling of bootstrap configuration changes (referenced but not implemented here).

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory exists at the given path.

methods.name: getParentDirectory
methods.description: Extracts the parent directory from a given file path.

methods.name: createFile
methods.description: Creates a new file at the specified path.

methods.name: createBspCompleteFiles
methods.description: Creates necessary files and directories for BSP completion status.

methods.name: getAuthServicePartnerID
methods.description: Monitors the partner ID file via inotify, creates necessary files, and detects partner ID changes to trigger configuration updates.

methods.name: resetCacheAndStore
methods.description: Clears internal cache and deletes the bootstrap store file.

methods.name: getPartnerDeviceConfig
methods.description: Loads device-specific bootstrap defaults from JSON and overrides generic defaults.

methods.name: loadFromJson
methods.description: Loads bootstrap configuration from JSON files based on partner ID.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key.

methods.name: setRawValue
methods.description: Sets a configuration value, updates files, and manages journal entries.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value and populates HOSTIF_MsgData_t.

methods.name: clearRfcValues
methods.description: Clears RFC configuration values and resets to defaults.

methods.name: overrideValue
methods.description: Overrides a configuration parameter based on HOSTIF_MsgData_t, handling special bootstrap control parameters.

methods.name: initBSPropertiesFileName
methods.description: Initializes bootstrap properties filename and journal from RFC properties file.

methods.name: loadBSPropertiesIntoCache
methods.description: Loads bootstrap properties into internal cache from file and JSON.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the bootstrap store, loading configuration files and setting up internal state.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern to get the instance of XBSStore, starting partner ID monitoring thread if needed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the partner ID monitoring thread to stop.
